title: Sorcerer in Crimson Ritual
description: A long-haired, bearded man stands in a dimly lit room, both hands raised with fingers splayed as he channels glowing blue magical energy from a tall cylindrical device on a wooden table. Shadowy, ethereal hands and figures loom on the walls behind him while papers, candles, and arcane objects are scattered across the table.
